translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
translations.original:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.

If you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.

A planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,
then grow BERRIES again.

I want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.
That's my dream.

Please help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.
translations.zh: 树果树只会生长在柔软肥沃的土壤里。摘下树果后，记得再种下一颗。种下的树果会发芽、长大、开出美丽的花，然后再次结出树果。我的梦想是让全世界开满美丽的花。{PLAYER}{KUN}，请你也帮忙种树果，让世界多一些花吧！

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
translations.original:
Flowers bring so much happiness to
people, don't they?
translations.zh: 鲜花能带给大家很多快乐，你说是不是？

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
translations.original:
I'm trying to be like my big sisters.
I'm growing flowers, too!

Here you go!
It's for you!
translations.zh: 我也想像姐姐们一样，所以也在种花！这个送给你！

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
translations.original:
Your name is?

{PLAYER}{KUN}.
That's a nice name.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about
BERRIES?
translations.zh: 你叫什么名字？……{PLAYER}{KUN}，真是个好名字。{PLAYER}{KUN}，想了解一下树果吗？

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
translations.original:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about
BERRIES?

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
translations.original:
You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,
or you can make a POKéMON hold it.

But now they have a machine that mixes
up different BERRIES and makes candies
for POKéMON.

I want some candy, too.
translations.zh: 树果可以种下长成大树，也可以让宝可梦携带。现在还有一种机器，能把不同树果混合起来，做成给宝可梦吃的糖果。我也想尝尝那种糖果！

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
translations.original:
Hello!

This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.
Spreading flowers all over the world!
translations.zh: 你好！这里是漂亮花瓣花店，我们希望鲜花开遍全世界！

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
translations.original:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.

Oh, another thing.

If you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.
But they'll sprout again.

Isn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.
translations.zh: 树果树生长时，可以用吼吼鲸喷壶给它浇水。还有啊，成熟的树果一直不摘就会掉在地上，不过之后还会重新发芽。它们的生命力很强呢！

translations.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
translations.original:
Hello!

The more attention you give to flowers,
the more beautifully they bloom.

You'll like tending flowers. I'm sure
of it. You can have this.
translations.zh: 你好！越用心照顾花，花就会开得越美。你一定也会喜欢照顾花的，这个送给你！

translations.label: gText_PlayerWhatCanIDoForYou
translations.original:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, welcome!

What can I do for you?

translations.label: gText_TooBadBagIsFull
translations.original:
Too bad!
The BAG is full…

facts.summary: 未见店主或未取得第三枚徽章时，OnTransition把店主永久位置置为(4,6)。见过且三徽章时为原模板(0,3)，并切入销售植物装饰分支；后者未实现。
每日树果从最初八种中选择，包满不记领取。网页沿用每日奖励账本，用保存seed和RTC日计算可重放选择；不是原作全局LCRNG调用时序。喷壶领取事实在奖励原子提交时登记，以便后续对白中断后不重发。

scenarios.name: 花店早期真实入口、取消与领取重入
scenarios.start: 店主未见，未有第三徽章；已设时钟。
steps: 进入花店与店主互动，分别选择想/不想
与两位妹妹互动领取喷壶和树果
把对应口袋填满后互动，再腾位重试
保存读档同日互动，随后推进到次日再互动
scenarios.expected: 正确早期位置，不与玩家重叠；喷壶仅一次，树果每天一次；包满不登记奖励，同日重载不重复领取。
